About

My passion for numbers and statistics started when I was just 6 years old. My father used to ask me simple math questions, and I always enjoyed answering them. Since then, I've never lost that passion for numbers and problem-solving.

About two years ago, while studying Business Information Systems, I started learning data analytics tools and applying my knowledge through hands-on projects.

Today, I'm continuously developing my skills in data analysis, visualization, and business intelligence using tools like Excel, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, and Python libraries.

I'm always eager to learn, explore data, and turn numbers into meaningful insights.
